source: MMPose VideoPose3D, one frame, fully convolutional, supervised, fine-tuned on CPN 2D poses (videopose_h36m_1frame_fullconv_supervised_cpn_ft-5c3afaed_20210527.pth), exported with dev/lifting/export_videopose.py
license: The code and the weights of MMPose are Apache-2.0, but the network was trained on Human3.6M, whose license allows only academic, non-commercial research. Check this before releasing the game with this file; the game runs without it (no 3D pose then).

input.name: keypoints_2d
input.description: The 17 joints of Human3.6M (see PoseLifter.cs), x and y interleaved, normalized: (x - w / 2) / (w / 2), (y - h / 2) / (w / 2).

output.name: keypoints_3d
output.description: The 17 joints in 3D, x, y and z interleaved, in meters, relative to the pelvis; x right, y down, z away from the camera.
